svg.title: CH341A dongle (V357) in I2C/SPI mode: the headers
svg.text: CH341A dongle (V357) in I2C/SPI mode: the headers
Top view, USB-A down. Each hole: its silkscreen (the side rows' from the back), its role in mode 1a86:5512, atiic's name.
same chip pin as a header hole
The pair by the USB, right: 3V3. VCC and the chip at 3.3 V (the board comes on 5 V)
The one by the USB, left: I2C/SPI. 1a86:5512, atiic's mode; UART is a serial port (1a86:5523)
• atiic drives D0-D5 high, low or released (pins()) and reads D0-D7 (readPins()); SPI is SCK D3, MOSI D5, MISO D7, chip selects any of D0-D5.
• The header's CS0-CS2, SCK, MOSI, MISO are D0-D3, D5, D7 again on the left-hand row (dashed); D4 and D6 are on that row only.
• SPI shifts least significant bit first: atiic reverses each byte. About 110 KB/s; mode 0 only.
• The header's TXD and RXD are UART mode's; in I2C/SPI mode the same chip pins are ERR and PEMP, inputs.
• The right-hand row is the EPP/MEM parallel port's (DS, AS, WAIT, RST, SLCT, INT, ERR, PEMP), and WR on the left: atiic doesn't use them.

Holes from the vendor's photos (YouXin, front and back: the back flipped top to bottom); chip pins from WCH CH341DS1, the CH341A (SOP-28) column (§4.2-4.6); not traced on the board. atiic docs/ch341.md, docs/setup.md.
